title: Fix AI script generator navigation from trending topics

requirements.text: Update the TrendingTopicCard component (frontend/src/components/TrendingTopicCard.tsx) to properly serialize and pass the complete trending topic data object when the 'Create Video' button is clicked, ensuring the navigation to VideoConfigurationPage includes the topic ID, title, hashtags, keywords, platform, and engagement metrics as URL parameters or navigation state

quotes: you're trying to generate the AI script by clicking on a trending topic from the Trending page

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Create Video' button on any trending topic card successfully navigates to VideoConfigurationPage
The VideoConfigurationPage receives and displays the topic title without showing 'Topic not found' error
All topic data (hashtags, keywords, platform, metrics) is accessible in VideoConfigurationPage for script generation

requirements.text: Verify that the VideoConfigurationPage component (frontend/src/pages/VideoConfigurationPage.tsx) correctly extracts and displays trending topic data from URL parameters or navigation state when arriving from TrendingPage, showing the topic title in the UI and pre-populating the script generation form
acceptanceCriteria: VideoConfigurationPage successfully extracts topic data from URL parameters or navigation state
Topic title is displayed prominently on the VideoConfigurationPage
Script generation form is accessible and functional with the topic context
No 'Topic not found' errors appear when navigating from trending topics

requirements.text: Ensure the 'Generate Script' functionality on VideoConfigurationPage is properly triggered and working when users click the script generation button, displaying the generated script content in an editable textarea without navigation or initialization errors

quotes: it properly opens the Video Configuration page with the AI script generator working correctly

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Generate Script' button is visible and clickable on VideoConfigurationPage
Clicking 'Generate Script' triggers the script generation mutation without errors
Generated script content appears in an editable textarea after generation completes
Loading states are displayed during script generation
Error messages are shown if script generation fails

constraints: Use the hardcoded mock trending topics data structure currently in TrendingPage.tsx
Maintain compatibility with the URL parameter extraction utilities in frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts
Do not modify the backend trending topics API or data models
Preserve the existing VideoConfigurationPage layout and UI components
nonGoals: Implementing real-time trending topic fetching from external APIs
Modifying the backend script generation logic or parameters
Changing the visual design or styling of TrendingTopicCard or VideoConfigurationPage
Adding new video configuration options beyond script generation
